description: Change a team group's POWERS (and its name). These are not rights on tables — those are set_table_permission. Here is what a person may DO in the project: manage the team (can_add_users / can_edit_access_rights / can_delete_users), create portals, charts, maps, calendars, mailings, work with files. Pass ONLY the keys that must change: keys not passed are NOT touched, so that settings made earlier by hand are not undone.

can_add_users.description: May add people to the team

can_delete_users.description: May remove people from the team

can_edit_access_rights.description: May change other people's rights. ⚠️ This is NOT «the Admin role» — a role is set through set_table_permission/set_user_role with the value owner; this is only a separate power.

name: update_team_group
